card.name: The digit 7 inside numbers
card.fires_on: The digit 7 when it appears as part of a longer number, often the last digit of a page, verse, year or range. It is common in citations, scripture references, dates and numeric ranges.

modes.label: Citation and verse numbers
modes.description: The digit 7 ending or inside a page, volume or Bible verse number.

modes.label: Numeric ranges and dates
modes.description: The digit 7 in the second part of a range, a year, or a day count.
